# Row G5 (docs/gpu-experiments/03-acceleration/05-session-plan.md): the three fusions, each alone on the 2-layer
# graph with the boundary compare and on the model with the ids (O1 the router norm, O2 the silu into w2, O3 the
# norm into the per-tile linear), then the three together. A lever stays on if its compare passes and the event
# clock is lower than G2's; the rows are independent, so a lever that fails does not touch the others; the agent
# removes a failed lever from the stacked rows here and in queue-d7/d8/d9 with queue_flag.py --remove.
